errors.text: The proposed FCC+BCC intervention does not reconstruct the compositionally segregated FCC+C14 Laves microstructure of rapidly quenched FeCoNiTi.
The cited evidence primarily supports changes in phase fraction and saturation magnetization, not increased coercivity or domain-wall pinning by a BCC phase.
No quantitative coercivity prediction, measurement temperature, or magnetic-transition signature is specified.
